primary_text_observation: NPS describes a concave edifice, steeper upper slopes, common main summit vent and erosion. It explicitly rejects an obligatory orderly-stratified description. Scope remains generic, not Iliamna reconstruction.
reference_pixels: Actual1300x864 Iliamna image personally opened: unequal branching ridges and inset lower shoulders; snow obscures rock and vent. No claim of measured dimensions.
concept_pixels: Original four-panel concept personally opened. Stratovolcano has clearly differentiated branching middle flanks; original r006 has smooth broad wedge faces. Concept is artistic guidance only.
diagnosis: Agree with independent defect: long smooth panels dominate nearly all slopes; mathematical secondary buttresses do not create readable branch junctions. Retain steep concave silhouette, broad skirt and small closed summit vent.
